messages:
alisha-cs: FYI ticket from SentinelCo — PO 980-CC-2026 has a contract promo note but credits never landed on their account. Customer is on a live trial and experiencing quota/billing noise. Can someone triage? :wave:

sam-billing: putting the PO and invoice here — they uploaded the signed PO and included the promo clause. I tried reapplying the credit via admin panel but the UI says 'promo matched' and zero credits applied.

alisha-cs: exact text in PO: "Apply enterprise promo: CONTRACT-SENTINEL-APR2026 — net credit to be applied to invoice as per contract notes."

james-sales: I confirmed we approved this promo in the deal and added the PO note when closing. I didn't trigger the manual grant — assumed billing would auto-apply. My bad, happy to sign off on manual adjustment.

jess-platform: quick question — is this a metadata parsing failure? We had a bug last quarter where PO notes with hyphenated codes didn't match the billing regex. If someone can paste the PO note verbatim I can check logs.

sam-billing: pasted above. Also attaching the minimal invoice excerpt we used to repro: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-1407
Customer: SentinelCo
PO: 980-CC-2026
Note: Apply enterprise promo: CONTRACT-SENTINEL-APR2026
```

mike-ops: I pulled the billing-service logs for that invoice id range — seeing a promo-match request at 2026-04-11T15:03Z but the apply step returns 204 with body `{\"applied\":false, \"reason\":\"no_matching_contract_rule\"}`. Looks like matcher didn't find contract entry in promotions table.

jess-platform: that aligns with the hyphen-regex suspicion. The matcher expects tokenized `CONTRACT SENTINEL APR2026` or a normalized coupon id field. Sales sometimes add condensed tokens. I'll try a quick normalizer patch locally.

alisha-cs: customer is asking for immediate manual credit so their usage spike doesn't trigger overage alerts. They want confirmation today.

james-sales: authorize manual grant. I approve applying the full contracted credit for April invoice. Please note PO and contract reference when you apply.

sam-billing: can someone paste the exact quantity/credit amount? Contract says $15,000 one-time credit for April usage. Need ledger memo and original PO reference for audit.

alisha-cs: confirmed amount $15,000. Customer expects proof (credit memo) and updated billing dashboard.

mike-ops: I'll do the manual ledger adjustment but need help constructing the internal audit note. Suggested memo: `Manual credit granted per PO 980-CC-2026 — CONTRACT-SENTINEL-APR2026 — approved by james-sales`. OK?

james-sales: yep OK. Also please cc finance-bot for workflow.

finance-bot: Received manual credit request. Generating approval flow ID: FB-APRV-5512. Please attach PO and sales approval.

sam-billing: applied manual credit (ledger id LD-77521). Credit posted against INV-2026-1407 for $15,000. Audit memo: `Manual credit granted per PO 980-CC-2026 — CONTRACT-SENTINEL-APR2026 — approved by james-sales (FB-APRV-5512)`.

alisha-cs: sending confirmation to customer now. Also documenting repro steps so eng can fix root cause:
1) Customer uploads PO with promo note to OSS portal.
2) Billing ingest creates promo_match job.
3) Promo matcher normalizes note but hyphenated token not recognized -> `no_matching_contract_rule`.
4) No auto-apply; UI shows 'promo matched' due to partial metadata match but credits 0 applied.

jess-platform: thanks — I'll push a small normalizer in the matcher to strip punctuation and run a backfill for recent PO notes. Also will add a smoke test for hyphenated promo codes.

mike-ops: backfill queued, running on staging now. I'll schedule a production backfill after we validate. ETA for prod backfill: EOD tomorrow if staging checks good.

alisha-cs: final checklist for this thread:
- [x] manual credit applied ($15k) by sam-billing (LD-77521)
- [x] sales approval recorded (james-sales, FB-APRV-5512)
- [ ] matcher fix + backfill (jess-platform + mike-ops)
- [x] customer notified about credit and dashboard update

jess-platform: I'll follow up with a PR and add the test. Will post the changelog here when merged. :thumbsup:

alisha-cs: thanks everyone — closing thread once prod backfill scheduled. :pray:
